hero.eet: EET 2.0 is mandatory from 1 Jan 2027. SalonGo is ready
hero.title: Bookings, checkout, EET. Your whole salon in one app.
hero.lead: Salon software for nail, hair, lash and beauty studios in Czechia. Clients book online, you take payment at the desk, and every receipt goes to EET by itself. By evening you know what came in and what went out.
hero.note: No card needed. Support in Czech, Vietnamese and English.
hero.altDesktop: SalonGo calendar with a column for each staff member, on a computer
hero.altPhone: SalonGo checkout screen on a phone

day.title: A day at the salon, from the first booking to closing time
day.lead: Each part of SalonGo takes one familiar job off your hands.

s1.title: Clients book themselves, even before you open
s1.desc: Your salon gets its own booking page. Clients pick a service and a time in 4 steps, in Czech, German, English, Slovak or French.

s2.title: A calendar per staff member, shared out automatically
s2.desc: One column per person. Bookings without a chosen stylist go to whoever is free. Staff see their own day on their phone.

s3.title: Checkout at the desk, receipts sent to EET
s3.desc: Pick the services, take cash, card or a QR transfer. The 80 mm receipt prints and is reported to the tax office straight away.

s4.title: Income & expenses: see what you actually made
s4.desc: Income adds up from your receipts. Log an expense in seconds: stock, rent, a note. Income minus expenses is right there.

s5.title: Payroll works itself out
s5.desc: Commission or a fixed wage, tips per client or split evenly. Export to Excel, CSV or PDF.

more.title: And the small things that keep the salon running
more.customersDesc: History, spend, regulars and clients you haven't seen in a while. A birthday reminder 2 days ahead.
more.marketingDesc: Templates for Women's Day, Christmas and birthdays. Send them to the clients you choose.
more.branchesDesc: One account for every salon. Switch with one tap and see the revenue of all of them on one page.
more.staffDesc: Staff see their own bookings and get notifications in their language. You decide what else they see.
more.invoicesDesc: Find and reprint any receipt, filtered by date, staff member and payment method.
more.devicesDesc: The front desk uses an iPad or computer, staff use their phones. The data is always the same.

videos.title: See the app in action
videos.lead: Recorded in the current SalonGo app with sample data.

booking.title: New booking
booking.desc: Pick the client, service and stylist on the calendar. The client gets a confirmation email.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.desc: Choose services and the payment method, print a receipt with the EET code.

thuchi.title: Income & expenses
thuchi.desc: See today's income and add an expense with a note.

customers.title: Clients
customers.desc: Search for a client, open the profile, see history and spend.

online.title: Online booking
online.desc: Your salon's booking page on a client's phone.

desk.title: Chair plan
desk.desc: A chair renter rings up a sale and checks their own income and expenses.

who.title: Pick the plan that fits how you work
who.salonDesc: Calendar, online booking, checkout, EET, payroll, clients and several locations. Three plans by team size, every feature in each.
who.deskTitle: You rent a chair and work for yourself
who.deskDesc: Checkout, receipts and EET with your own certificate, your own income and expenses. The salon owner can't see your revenue.

eet.title: EET 2.0 is mandatory from 1 Jan 2027. No extra till needed.
eet.lead: Switch EET on once in the app. From then on every receipt is reported to the tax office and printed with its FIK code.
eet.p1: Upload the certificate from DIS+, enter its password and the outlet number. Done.
eet.p2: Included in every plan, Chair too. No extra fee.
eet.p3: Need help getting the certificate? Our support team does it with you.

pricing.title: Clear prices, paid monthly
pricing.lead: Every plan has every feature, only the number of staff and locations differs. Change or renew your plan on the web any time and the app updates straight away.
pricing.trial: New salons try it free for {days} days, no card needed.
pricing.yearly: Pay yearly and save up to {discount}%.

website.title: Need a website for your salon?
website.desc: A 5-page salon website for 999 Kč, only for SalonGo customers.

final.title: Open an account in 2 minutes. Try it for {days} days.
final.lead: No card needed. When the trial ends, your data stays put.
